commandText:
SELECT [a].[EntryID], [a].[DisciplineID], [a].[DueDate], [a].[Grade], [a].[GradeDate], [a].[IsViewedByStudent], [a].[IsViewedByTeacher], [a].[Name], [a].[StatusID], [a].[StudentID]
FROM [Assignments] AS [a]
INNER JOIN [Disciplines] AS [d] ON [a].[DisciplineID] = [d].[EntryID]
WHERE [d].[TeacherID] = @__teacherID_0 AND [a].[GradeDate] IS NULL
